name: tmcp
description: Expose standalone TMCP skill-packet workflows, skill harvesting, workflow recommendations, and expert UI rubric remediation to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Route work through TMCP skill packets and expert rubrics.
interface.longDescription: TMCP exposes task-specific skill packet compilation, local skill harvesting, harvest-driven workflow recommendations, and expert rubric remediation workflows for UI, evidence, security, developer-experience, and general audits. It runs standalone and can use AIOS as an optional acceleration and persistence adapter when available.
defaultPrompt: Use the TMCP expert UI rubric on this project.
Explain the TMCP packet for this task.
Run tmcp_doctor and verify this install.
Harvest this repo into a TMCP packet.
Recommend TMCP workflows from this repo's skill signals.
